text:
[NLFC.10.3] **Integrator configuration never selects a strategy.** The
engine executes under the artefact's recorded settings and nothing else
([RDSC.16.2.1]). Sizing calls, such as setting the cache bounds
([NSTG.2.6.1]), supply capacities; they must not switch the engine between
strategies. In this edition every artefact has `constspace: false`
([LCAP.2.1.5]), and there is no working-memory bound ([NRTM.3.1]).
